blocks.name: Active transport
blocks.definition: Describe active transport as the movement of particles through a cell membrane from a region of lower concentration to a region of higher concentration (i.e. against a concentration gradient), using energy from respiration

blocks.md: - Active transport is the movement of particles through a cell membrane from a region of **lower concentration** to a region of **higher concentration** using [energy from respiration](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/biology/cie/23/revision-notes/12-respiration/12-1-respiration/12-1-1-respiration-in-cells/?_ai=internal-linking)

blocks.alt: Diagram of active transport: carrier proteins move particles across a cell membrane from low concentration outside the cell to higher concentration inside.
blocks.caption: The process of active transport
